step_by_step_approach: List every model together with its name, version, and associated L1_model.
For each model, examine each of its steps and record the test score of the Stack model.
For each step, determine the highest test score among models that are not Stack.
Label a model as strong if any of its steps have a Stack score greater than the highest non‑Stack score for that step.
Label a model as soft if any of its steps have a Stack score equal to the highest non‑Stack score for that step.
Pair each model's determined status (strong or soft) with its L1_model.
Count how many times each L1_model appears with a strong status across all models.
Count how many times each L1_model appears with a soft status across all models.
Select the L1_model with the highest count among those labeled strong and note its count.
Select the L1_model with the highest count among those labeled soft and note its count.
